text:
decided to put my GPUs where my mouth is

64 hours ago, I started decompiling Just Cause 2 using a bespoke harness, three xx90-class GPUs, two computers, and (now) 22 parallel sessions of Qwen 3.8 27B with 45K context each

I now have 6% of functions (note: <1% bytecode) decompiled w/ byte-matching
